mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_product_interaction (user_id, product_id, view_count, last_view_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + 1, last_view_time = NOW()
mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_product_interaction (user_id, product_id, is_purchased, view_count, last_view_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, 1, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_purchased = 1
mapper.select: SELECT product_id FROM user_product_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_purchased = 1
SELECT product_id FROM user_product_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND view_count > 0 ORDER BY last_view_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.category_id FROM user_product_interaction upi JOIN product p ON upi.product_id = p.id WHERE upi.user_id = #{userId} AND upi.view_count > 0 GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY MAX(upi.last_view_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
